steps.text:
All three probes stay paused, and I've changed nothing. They're still Ready, so build-planning won't plan S1 yet, but pipeline-design and test-planning can carry on.

I didn't record the 21:37 run, so `dt status` will keep listing PB-01 to PB-03 as having new results until your next real run. When you re-run:

1. Run `env | grep -i base_url` in the same terminal first, and check it prints nothing.
2. Run PB-01 `access`, then `collect`, then PB-02 `identity`.
3. Check that each `evidence/results.json` shows `https://api.sharadar.com/v1.0/data`.
4. Run `uv run --script probes/PB-03-yahooquery-history/probe.py compare`.

Then say "ran it" and I'll record the results.
